title: Epictetus
html_source:
Epictetus was a Greek philosopher who taught that philosophy is a way of life and not just theoretical discipline. To him, all events in life are determined by fate and beyond our control, meaning that we should accept whatever happens to us calmly.

With the unfortunate experiences Stephen goes through in the book, his state of being become worse when he focuses and overthinks his problems instead of just accepting them.
